title: BenchMIRT：大语言模型基准测试究竟在衡量什么？
summary: 本文介绍了由艾伦人工智能研究所（AI2）提出的BenchMIRT框架，旨在深入剖析大语言模型（LLM）基准测试的实际测量内容。传统基准测试仅提供总分，难以揭示模型能力的具体维度。BenchMIRT通过将基准测试问题分解为多个认知技能（如知识检索、数学推理、指令遵循等），并利用LLM自动标注每个问题所需的技能组合，从而生成细粒度的技能画像。该框架还引入了技能混淆矩阵，展示模型在不同技能上的表现差异，帮助研究者识别模型的真实强项与弱点。文章以MMLU等基准为例，演示了BenchMIRT如何揭示模型在特定技能上的表现与总分之间的不一致性，并讨论了其对基准设计、模型评估和训练数据选择的启示。BenchMIRT的核心价值在于提供了一种可解释、可操作的基准分析工具，推动LLM评估从单一分数向多维能力理解转变，对模型开发者和下游用户均有重要参考意义。
summary_en: This article introduces BenchMIRT, a framework developed by the Allen Institute for AI (AI2) to deeply analyze what LLM benchmarks actually measure. Traditional benchmarks provide only aggregate scores, obscuring specific model capabilities. BenchMIRT decomposes benchmark questions into multiple cognitive skills (e.g., knowledge retrieval, mathematical reasoning, instruction following) and uses LLMs to automatically annotate the skill composition required by each question, generating fine-grained skill profiles. The framework also introduces a skill confusion matrix to show performance variations across skills, helping researchers identify true strengths and weaknesses. Using benchmarks like MMLU as examples, BenchMIRT reveals inconsistencies between overall scores and performance on specific skills, and discusses implications for benchmark design, model evaluation, and training data selection. The core value of BenchMIRT lies in providing an interpretable and actionable tool for benchmark analysis, shifting LLM evaluation from a single score to multi-dimensional capability understanding, which is valuable for both developers and downstream users.
